rows.label: bf04120190_0010
rows.name:
So that's what happened. Could you overlook
them stealing the ship?

rows.label: bf04120190_0020
rows.name:
You're the one asking, so I hate to refuse.
I understand the circumstances, but...

rows.label: bf04120190_0040
rows.name: Well, the ship did come back safely...

rows.label: bf04120190_0050
rows.name:
I don't know if this
makes up for it, but...

rows.label: bf04120190_0060
rows.name:
Could you put them to work at the Trading Company
as part of making amends?

rows.label: bf04120190_0090
rows.name: Rex, you mean make them salvagers?

rows.label: bf04120190_0100
rows.name:
I think they have potential. They're also
dexterous with their hands... right?

rows.label: bf04120190_0110
rows.name:
Come on, please. They're poor kids
with nowhere else to go, you know?

rows.label: bf04120190_0120
rows.name: You'll be punished if you abandon them, you know.

rows.label: bf04120190_0130
rows.name: Jeez, you... Fine, I get it.

rows.label: bf04120190_0150
rows.name:
But at first, only food, clothes, and lodging.
You get paid once you're fully fledged.

rows.label: bf04120190_0160
rows.name: That's what he says. Was that too meddlesome of me?
